instrument_name: Co-Occurring AOD, Mental Health and DFV Risk & Capacity Assessment

items.text: Current physical safety risk to parent/caregiver from partner or ex-partner
Evidence of coercive control (isolation, financial control, monitoring, threats)
Child exposure to DFV incidents (witnessed, used as weapon, present in home)
Parent's current safety plan adequacy and use
Frequency/pattern of use impairing supervision or judgment
Engagement with AOD treatment (concurrent, not sequential to other goals)
Relapse risk indicators and relapse management plan tied to safety plan
Substance use directly implicated in prior safety incident
Capacity to respond to child's emotional/physical distress
Symptom-driven impairment to supervision or emotional availability
Engagement with mental health treatment (trauma-informed, concurrent)
Insight into how symptoms affect parenting decisions
Availability of non-offending support network
Parent's ability to prioritise child safety over relationship/substance pressures
History of protective action taken when risk identified

domains.domain_name: Perpetrator Accountability and Behaviour Change (where applicable)

items.text: Enrollment and attendance in men's/perpetrator behaviour change program
Demonstrated behaviour change independent of self-report
Ongoing risk indicators (breaches, contact violations, threats)
Information sharing/coordination across DFV, AOD, MH providers in place
Conflicting service requirements identified and resolved (e.g. confidentiality vs disclosure)
Observed child behavioural/emotional impact attributable to household DFV/AOD/MH
Child's expressed sense of safety in the home (age-appropriate)

critical_overrides.rationale: Active physical safety risk overrides aggregate score
Child direct exposure to DFV overrides aggregate score
Substance use directly implicated in prior safety incident overrides aggregate score
Symptom-driven supervision impairment overrides aggregate score
Ongoing perpetrator risk indicators override aggregate score regardless of other domain trends

cross_domain_rules.description: An improving AOD trend across timepoints must not offset an active DFV critical override in RRI composite
Victim-parent case plan and perpetrator accountability tracking must never share a single goal set or be scored as one unit
